data.long_meaning: Rupan means 'jewel' or 'wealth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rup' which means 'form' or 'shape'. The name signifies the beauty and value that one holds within themselves. The name Rupan carries the meaning “Jewel, wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rupan usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rupan is a spiritual name that represents the inner beauty and wealth of an individual. It is a reminder to value oneself and appreciate the form and shape of the universe.

It is often given to children who are believed to embody these qualities and bring them into their families and communities. The name is also a reminder of the importance of valuing one's inner beauty and wisdom above material possessions.

historical_references.reference: Rupan, a well-known Hindu poet, lived during the Gupta Empire in the 5th and 6th centuries CE. He is known for his works in Sanskrit, such as the Vaisnavamahatmya and the Harivamsa. His poems celebrate the divine qualities of Vishnu and Krishna.

historical_references.reference: Rupan, a mathematician and astronomer, is considered to be a predecessor to Bhaskara I during the 12th century CE in India. His works on algebra, geometry, and astronomy influenced Bhaskara I's mathematical developments. One of Rupan's major works is the 'Siddhanta Siromani', which contains several treatises on mathematics and astronomy.
